checks.label: Duplicate payment verification
checks.detail: No high-confidence duplicates after filtering 154 batch payments and 11908 CSV overlaps. Previous false positives eliminated.

checks.label: Split payment analysis
checks.detail: 158 suspect instances (£39.5M, 0.8% of spend). Threshold: 5+ payments to same supplier in same week, 80%+ of approval limit.

checks.label: Year-end spike verification
checks.detail: Highest spike: 2.2x in Moor End Academy - B. Year-end spikes are common in public sector (capital programmes, grants). Only extreme spikes (>3x) warrant concern.

checks.label: CH breach temporal verification
checks.detail: 8 suppliers with £165.2K confirmed during active breach periods. Enrichment errors excluded. Only dated violations with confirmed overlap flagged.

checks.label: Benford's Law forensic screening
checks.detail: Significant deviation from Benford's Law (p < 0.001). χ²=25674.9 on 487722 amounts >£100. Largest deviation: digit 4 (4.4% off expected).

warnings: Benford's Law analysis shows significant deviation (χ²=25674.9). Digit 4 deviates 4.4% from expected. This warrants investigation but can also occur with legitimate round-number grants or threshold-based payments.
